name: Run to You (지금 널 찾아가고 있어)

lines.lyric_hangul: 눈물을 꾹 참으며 두려운 (내 맘을)
lines.lyric_translation: Holding back my tears, hiding my fear

lines.lyric_hangul: 감추고서 너를 찾아서 갈 거야
lines.lyric_translation: I will go to you

lines.lyric_hangul: 자려다 네 생각에 일어나 밖으로 나가서는
lines.lyric_translation: I was about to sleep / But I woke up from thinking of you and went outside

lines.lyric_hangul: 걷다가 또 보니까 내 맘처럼 달리고 있는 나
lines.lyric_translation: I was walking / But started running just like my heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 너 있는 그곳을 나는 몰라도
lines.lyric_translation: Even though I don’t know where you are

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 마음 나침반 곧장 따라서
lines.lyric_translation: I’m following the compass of my heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 맘에 그려둔 지도를 천천히 살펴서
lines.lyric_translation: Slowly looking through / The map in my heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 찾아가면 되지, 조금 멀면 어때
lines.lyric_translation: Then I can find you, who cares if it’s a bit far?

lines.lyric: Uri duri ieojyeo itneun seoneul ttaraseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 우리 둘이 이어져 있는 선을 따라서
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll follow the line that connects us two

lines.lyric: Nae ireum maeume saegyeotta malhal ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 이름 마음에 새겼다 말할 때
lines.lyric_translation: When you said you engraved my name in your heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 눈이 커진 이율 기억해
lines.lyric_translation: Remember why my eyes grew so big

lines.lyric: Jigeum nan neowa ttokgateun mueoshideun piryohae
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 난 너와 똑같은 무엇이든 필요해
lines.lyric_translation: Right now, you and I, we both need the same thing

lines.lyric: Hajiman naegen itji aneunikka uri dashi mannaja
lines.lyric_hangul: 하지만 나에겐 있지 않으니까 우리 다시 만나자
lines.lyric_translation: But I don’t have it so let’s meet again later

lines.lyric: Naega dochakhagi jeonkkaji jal jinaego isseoya hae
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 도착하기 전까지 잘 지내고 있어야 해
lines.lyric_translation: Please be well until I get there

lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 널 찾아가고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: I’m going to you right now

lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 시간 하나, 둘 네가 없는 시간 하나, 둘
lines.lyric_translation: Your time, one by one / Times without you, one by one

lines.lyric_hangul: 가는 소리 들려도 내 맘에 소비 기간은 없어
lines.lyric_translation: I hear it passing / But there’s no time to waste in my heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 너 없는 이 곳에 모든 시간도
lines.lyric_translation: All of the times in this place without you

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 마음 초침을 따라 흐르면
lines.lyric_translation: Follows the hands of my heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 언젠가 그 날이 꼭 올 거라고 믿으면서
lines.lyric_translation: Then I believe that some day / That day will come

lines.lyric_hangul: 찾아가면 되지, 조금 멀면 어때
lines.lyric_translation: Then I can find you, who cares if it’s a bit far?

lines.lyric: Uri duri ieojyeo itneun seoneul ttaraseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 우리 둘이 이어져 있는 선을 따라서
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll follow the line that connects us two

lines.lyric: Nae ireum maeume saegyeotta malhal ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 이름 마음에 새겼다 말할 때
lines.lyric_translation: When you said you engraved my name in your heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 눈이 커진 이율 기억해
lines.lyric_translation: Remember why my eyes grew so big

lines.lyric: Jigeum nan neowa ttokgateun mueoshideun piryohae
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 난 너와 똑같은 무엇이든 필요해
lines.lyric_translation: Right now, you and I, we both need the same thing

lines.lyric: Hajiman naegen itji aneunikka uri dashi mannaja
lines.lyric_hangul: 하지만 나에겐 있지 않으니까 우리 다시 만나자
lines.lyric_translation: But I don’t have it so let’s meet again later

lines.lyric: Naega dochakhagi jeonkkaji jal jinaego isseoya hae
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 도착하기 전까지 잘 지내고 있어야 해
lines.lyric_translation: Please be well until I get there

lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 널 찾아
lines.lyric_translation: I’m going to you right now

lines.lyric: Gago ittago ittago nae mameul jeonhae bwado
lines.lyric_hangul: 가고 있다고 있다고 내 맘을 전해 봐도
lines.lyric_translation: I’m going, I try to tell you my heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 혹시나 너에게 닿지 못하더라도
lines.lyric_translation: Even if it won’t reach you by any chance

lines.lyric: Deo naega jom deo sumchadeorado, ppalli gal teni
lines.lyric_hangul: 더 내가 좀 더 숨차더라도, 빨리 갈 테니
lines.lyric_translation: Even if I run out of breath more, I’ll go quickly

lines.lyric_hangul: 그곳에 서서 조금만 기다려줘
lines.lyric_translation: So please wait there a little more

lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 시간과 나의 시간이
lines.lyric_translation: The day when your time and my time faces each other

lines.lyric_hangul: 마주하는 날 안아 줄 거야
lines.lyric_translation: I will hold you

lines.lyric: Naega dochakhagi jeonkkaji jal jinaego isseoya hae
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 도착하기 전까지 잘 지내고 있어야 해
lines.lyric_translation: Please be well until I get there

lines.lyric_hangul: 정말 정말 보고 싶어
lines.lyric_translation: I really really / Miss you
